AUTHOR: Konovalov
TITLE: Underwater fish detection with weak multi-domain supervision
REGION: Palm Islands, near-shore Great Barrier Reef, Queensland, Australia (20 habitats incl. mangroves)
SPECIES: Binary fish/no-fish; example species shown: Lutjanus argentimaculatus, Chaetodon vagabundus, Caranx sexfasciatus (juveniles)
DATA: Own unbaited RUV clips from 20 habitats: FD10 (4,017 frames, every 10th frame) + FD10-Test (36,601 remaining frames); weak supervision from VOC2012 (negatives), LCF-15 and QUT2014 (positives)
V_EV: Sec. II-A: 'Recording sites varied in three-dimensional habitat architecture, levels of natural shading, current and wave energy levels, levels of suspended sediments, organic flocculation (marine snow), turbidity and salinity.' No results stratified by condition
D2: Every 10th frame of each clip -> FD10 (then 80/20 label-stratified train/val); remaining frames of the same clips -> FD10-Test
D_EV: Sec. II-A: 'the first, 11th, 21st, etc. frames (intervals of 10) were saved for training (denoted as FD10) and the remaining frames were saved separately for testing'; Sec. III-A: 'Since every 10th frame was used for training (or validation), it was reasonable to expect that the remaining test frames ... would be classified exactly'
R_EV: Sec. III-A: 'All FD10 and FD10c trained models (Table I) were applied to the FD10-Test dataset' — test frames come from the same project clips; external datasets used only for training
C_EV: Sec. III-A: 'The default 0.5 threshold was used to accept the CNN activation output as positive/fish'; Table I reports FP/N%, FN/P% and ROC AUC for each model
E_EV: Table I: 'Confusion matrix for the FD10-Test dataset' — only FP (FP/N%), FN (FN/P%) and AUC reported; no ecological variable
ARCH: Xception (ImageNet) with global max-pool head (XFishMp) or 1-class conv heatmap + max-pool (XFishHmMp); XFishHm heatmap for weak localization; trainable gray-to-RGB layer; CLAHE variant
METR: False-positive rate (FP/N), false-negative rate (FN/P), ROC AUC
NOTE: Frame-level image classifier (fish/no-fish) used as a detector; localization heatmaps only visually inspected ('Detailed analysis of the localization accuracy was left to future work'). Split is systematic (every 10th frame) rather than random, but train and test frames come from the same clips — coded 이미지/프레임 무작위; authors explicitly acknowledge expected near-perfect classification due to this (D4 = Y -> D_ALL = P). C_ALL = P is a judgment call: default 0.5 threshold used, no operating-point sweep, but ROC AUC (threshold-free) and FP/FN rates are discussed extensively, so the N condition ('no false-positive discussion') does not hold; verifier may prefer N. ENV coded 혼합 (near-shore GBR island chain incl. mangroves; merged.json says estuary). NIMG ~40,000 project frames ('In total the clips yielded 40,000 frames'). V3 = Y based only on qualitative 'levels of natural shading'.
